title: Virtual Compute: refund assessment — permitted payout
content:
## Calculation basis

Virtual Compute refund assessment — The permitted requested amount is the smallest of the negative receivable magnitude floored at zero, original payment principal minus prior disposal floored at zero, and the immediate payout ceiling; retain any surplus on account without further action.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for refund assessment — permitted payout?**

The permitted requested amount is the smallest of the negative receivable magnitude floored at zero, original payment principal minus prior disposal floored at zero, and the immediate payout ceiling; retain any surplus on account without further action.

## Hypothetical case

Hypothetically, the account surplus is 95 USD, the original principal is 140 USD with 65 USD already returned or refunded, and the payout ceiling is 80 USD. The remaining principal is 75 USD and the permitted requested amount is 75 USD.
